content.body:
When two connected nodes are accessed sequentially or simultaneously within the same context (Co-Access), the weight of the corresponding edge receives a boost, with the boost amount varying by relation type:

| Relation | Boost |
|----------|-------|
| `depends_on` | +0.30 |
| `extends` | +0.20 |
| `related_to` | +0.15 |
| `contradicts` | +0.10 |

Simultaneously triggers: co_access_count +1, last_co_accessed updated, weight capped at 1.0. Both the API route POST /edges/{id}/traverse and the MCP tool traverse_edge trigger the co-access boost.
